Hi Olivia —

Appreciate the request and timeline. Attached is a concise package addressing the items you listed. High-level summary below; full artifacts are attached and we can escalate to an NDA-exception process for deeper materials.

1) SAST/DAST
- SAST: We run static analysis on all service code (backend + infra-as-code) with nightly scans using a combination of open-source linters and commercial scanners (Semgrep + Checkmarx for packaged rules). High-risk issues (CWEs mapped to CVSS >= 7.0) are flagged to engineering triage immediately via our ticketing integration.
- DAST: Quarterly authenticated dynamic scans against staging and pre-prod environments (internal-only endpoints). We also run targeted runtime fuzzing for new parsers/ingest endpoints.
- Results: We include a rolling 90-day export of SAST/DAST findings; the attached SAST_DAST_Cadence_and_Results_OVERVIEW.docx contains sample exports and remediation KPIs.

2) Patch SLA and vulnerability disclosure timelines
- Critical (CVSS >= 9.0 or active exploit): remediation plan within 48 hours, hotfix or mitigation within 7 calendar days, full remediation within 30 days unless extended by documented risk acceptance.
- High (CVSS 7.0–8.9): remediation plan within 7 days, fix within 30 days.
- Medium/Low: tracked and scheduled in regular sprint cycles, with SLA targets published quarterly.
- We publish security advisories and customer-facing advisories for vulnerabilities that affect data residency or inference integrity; private customers (Dedicated/Private) receive direct notifications and mitigation guidance.

3) Pen test summary (last 12 months)
- Vendor: RedTeam Labs (independent third-party, ISO 27001 accredited)
- Scope: cloud control plane, hosted inference API, authentication flows, and model artifact storage (no customer PII in scope).
- Findings: 4 findings categorized as Medium, 2 as Low. No Criticals. All Medium items addressed within 21 days; full verification done and signed off. Summary attached: Redwood_PenTest_Summary_2025-11.pdf.

4) SBOM
- We produce a CycloneDX-compatible SBOM for core inference services and publish an export feed on request. Attached: SBOM_v202612.csv (column-mapped export). For customers requiring continuous SBOM access we can arrange an API feed or SFTP delivery under an NDA.

Next steps: I can (a) provide a redacted SOC2 artifact or point you to our compliance packet under an NDA; (b) schedule a 30-45 minute technical walk-through with our security engineering lead (cc'd: lauren.bishop) to go through any findings; or (c) provide an expanded CSV SBOM with provenance data. Which would be most useful for your team this week?

Best,

Michael Grant
Senior Sales Engineer — Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
O: 415-555-0198 | michael.grant@redwood.ai
